text:
violet-partnerships: Quick thread to finalize the multi-cloud onboarding checklist for marketplace listings + an optional hardware/SI appliance SKU. Keep replies terse so we can ship the sandbox upload Friday.

nate-cloud: I'll publish the publisher account IDs and the minimal IAM roles. Note: GCP requires a publisher service account with roles/cloudbilling.user; AWS needs an assume-role (aws-marketplace-publisher). Azure requires a tenant-level publisher principal.

logan-legal: I will draft the short-form marketplace EULA and an explicit KMS consent snippet for customers who provide an ARN. Also checking whether we need localized EU wording for FR/DE/ES.

sophia-product: SKU proposal (compact):
- rdi-dev: dev tier, token-limited, 7d trial
- rdi-pro: token-metered, 14d trial
- rdi-enterprise: reserved + SLA + SI add-on
- rdi-appliance: hardware partner listing (one-time + support plan)
Questions: do we include an "onboarding service" SKU for SIs or bundle as add-on?

rahul-ops: Ops notes: Private offers require customer KMS key ARN + cross-account policy; for Azure private we need subscription consent via MS marketplace flows. We'll prepare a terraform snippet and a cross-account KMS policy example. Also: store the support contact in the manifest (support_email) or validator fails.

manifest-bot: Heads-up: validator will reject manifests missing support_email or logo asset < 1024x1024. Use tag #manifest-errors on failures.

violet-partnerships: Good. Two quick asks before we finalize: 1) legal: a 1-paragraph KMS consent we can embed in the offer page; 2) ops: a one-page onboarding playbook (sample key policy + networking checklist) for partners. Can we get both by Wed EOD?

logan-legal: I can produce the paragraph and a short checklist by Wed. Draft will include explicit wording: customer provides KMS ARN and consents to cross-account key usage for encryption of customer-managed keys; logs retained only if customer opts into support-debug.

rahul-ops: I'll draft the terraform snippet + minimal KMS policy and a VPC diagram note by Wed too. Quick note for hardware partners: appliance SKU must include a separate support contact and an install-service SKU code.

sophia-product: For billing mapping, recommend we expose two billing units: token-unit for bursty usage, and reserved-hour for capacity commitments. SI onboarding fee as monthly seat add-on. If legal and ops sign off, I'll produce the final pricing.json and SKU manifest.

nate-cloud: I'll add publisher IDs and role templates to the shared drive today. Also creating a small test-publisher account pair for validation.

logan-legal: One question: do we ever retain full prompts in logs? Need to know for privacy clause language.

rahul-ops: No full prompts by default. We retain aggregated usage metrics. There is a "support-debug" mode that captures more telemetry for up to 7 days with explicit customer consent; include that in the paragraph.

manifest-bot: Reminder: after sandbox upload the validator will post schema errors here. Use #manifest-errors for followups.

violet-partnerships: Okay owners and deadlines: nate-cloud = publisher IDs & test accounts; logan-legal = EULA + KMS consent paragraph; sophia-product = SKU manifest + pricing.json; rahul-ops = KMS policy + terraform snippet + VPC notes. Aim: collect drafts Tue-Wed, preflight Thurs, upload to sandbox Fri. Sync Thu 10am PT to walk failures.

sophia-product: I'll add the appliance SKU fields (install_fee, support_tier) in the draft manifest. Also adding an "si_onboarding" boolean per SKU to enable partner flows.

logan-legal: I'll also add the Azure MSA clause for private offers; short checkbox for legal teams to confirm during partner onboarding.

nate-cloud: Uploaded initial IAM templates to drive. Linking in the thread: <link to drive placeholder>.

rahul-ops: Pushing terraform snippet now. It contains a cross-account KMS key policy example and an assume-role template for the publisher account. Will link in the drive.

violet-partnerships: Perfect. If any hardware or SI partner leads want to pilot the appliance SKU in the sandbox, reply here and I will invite them to the Thu sync.

sophia-product: tagging potential partners @hw-partners @si-leads — if you want in, reply with a contact and we'll add you.

manifest-bot: Note: missing support_email -> failure MF-002; missing logo -> MF-003.

violet-partnerships: Thanks team. I'll compile the artifacts and send the calendar invite for Thu 10am PT. Small follow-up: include a short acceptance criteria list for the sandbox run (manifest validates, private-offer flow works end-to-end with a test customer KMS, appliance SKU shows support contact).

nate-cloud: Acknowledged. I'll add test KMS ARNs for sandbox and a sample customer subscription for Azure test flows.

logan-legal: Drafts in drive by Wed morning.

rahul-ops: Terraform snippet and policy linked.

sophia-product: Pricing.json draft by Wed EOD.

violet-partnerships: Great work — short and focused. I'll post the preflight checklist and the invite shortly. :rocket:
